title: Aside (out of game)
prose: Yes to both. From now on every monster named in a heading, a stat line or a report carries its CR, next to the fight's difficulty and XP ("3 Grimlocks (CR 1/4 each) · Moderate, 150 XP").

Fights are reported live: a line when Morten tries something that matters, and a sentence or two when it resolves, with both sides' HP, round by round. On the page that is the live card; the fight lands as a section when it ends.

words.text: I'm also interested in seeing the challenge rating of monsters along with difficulty. And for fights, would it be possible to get reporting as the fight and rolling is happening?
